# \# Digital Wallet KYC Funnel \& Retention Analytics

# 

# Analysis of a digital-wallet user journey:

# Sign-up → KYC started → KYC approved → first transaction → repeat transaction.

# 

# \*\*Goal:\*\* find where users drop off and which customer groups have lower activation and retention.

# 

# \*\*Data:\*\* synthetic (simulated) dataset generated by `scripts/generate\_data.py`.

# 

# \*\*Tools:\*\* Python (data generation), Excel (cleaning), PostgreSQL (analysis), Power BI/Tableau (dashboard).

# 

# \## Project status

# \- \[ ] Week 1: Setup and data generation

# \- \[ ] Week 2: Excel cleaning and data-quality report

# \- \[ ] Week 3: SQL data model

# \- \[ ] Week 4: Funnel metrics

# \- \[ ] Week 5: Retention, cohorts and segmentation

# \- \[ ] Week 6: Dashboard

# \- \[ ] Week 7: Insight report
